title: Kandev marketplace registry
description: Proposed registry schema for plugin and canvas repositories. Preview image URLs belong to registry entries; release metadata remains package-owned.

plugins.description: The curated list of plugin repositories, one entry per plugin.

id.description: Stable plugin identifier. MUST equal the plugin manifest `id` of the repo's latest release. Unique across the file.

repo.description: GitHub repository in owner/name form; the release source for this plugin.

featured.description: When true, a maintainer has pinned this entry above star order in the catalog.

categories.description: Curation-only category tags used for filtering in the catalog.

kind.description: Omitted kind means plugin for backward compatibility; canvas kind must match the validated package.

previews.description: Ordered preview images. First image is the cover. Optional for plugins; required for canvas registry listings.

url.description: Direct HTTPS image URL. Credentials and fragments are rejected by registry validation.

alt.description: Description of the preview image for accessibility.
